sequential_dependency.step_a: Split the staging area into same-color four-connected components; locate each component color in the destination-band interiors.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Erase the source area and translate each component to its selected band floor, painting the measured marker color at its original columns.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The target row and output color cannot be known from component geometry alone; the input bands supply both. Using the global last-band floor instead of the matched floor changes the resulting placements.
